paragraphs: R' Yudan of Galilee. R' Yochanan, his son; Yelammedenu, section Acharei (as cited in Seder HaDorot).[^1][^2]

notes.text: בריה gives his son; the connected Yelammedenu citation belongs with Yochanan rather than being detached by a sentence stop. פ׳ is section, Acharei; no end-of-section locator is supplied. סה״ד is read contextually as Seder HaDorot, preserving Hyman’s attribution without a fresh collation.
The supplied גלילא, Galilee, differs from older machine נלילא. Both personal titles are abbreviated and remain R'; neither family relationship nor location establishes identity.
